meta.title: TwoMeows — bilingual audio fairy tales for kids aged 2–7
hero.title: Fairy tales that teach languages 📚
hero.sub: TwoMeows is a collection of bilingual audio fairy tales: your child listens to a story in their native language and picks up words of a second one without even noticing. With pictures, narration and magical word highlighting.
about.title: What is TwoMeows? 🎧
about.lead: It is a library of interactive audio fairy tales for little ones. A child listens to an engaging story in Ukrainian while key words are spoken in Slovak — with pictures, translation and clear pronunciation. A second language is absorbed naturally, like the native one: through story, play and repetition.
about.c1d: Every tale is narrated expressively and warmly — like mom or dad reading. Words light up in sync with the voice, karaoke-style.
about.c2d: Every new word comes with a bright illustration, translation and audio. The child sees, hears and remembers.
about.c3d: Speech, listening, attention, thinking and vocabulary develop on their own — while the child simply enjoys a favourite story.
how.title: How does it work? 🪄
how.s1d: Adventures, animals, space or a bedtime tale — matching your child's age and mood.
how.s2d: The text highlights along with the voice. Foreign words are colour-marked and pronounced extra clearly.
how.s3d: After the story comes a little review: the words with pictures the child just heard in the tale.
how.s4d: Stickers, superhero levels and a word treasury — so kids want to come back every day.
parents.title: Built with parents in mind 👨‍👩‍👧
parents.pedagogT: Every story is reviewed by an educator
parents.pedagogD: No story gets into the app without a review by an early-childhood development specialist. We check the content, vocabulary, pacing and age fit — and publish only what is truly useful and safe for a child.
parents.c1d: No ads, no external links, no random content. Only stories and learning.
parents.c2d: Put on a bedtime story — the app will quietly switch itself off once your little one falls asleep.
parents.c3d: Several kids — several profiles. Each with their own progress, favourite tales and rewards.
parents.c4d: How many stories listened to, how many words learned — you always see how your child is growing.
parents.c5d: Expressive narration and repetition enrich vocabulary in both the native and the second language.
parents.c6d: Stories run 10–15 minutes — enough to be useful, not too much screen time.
kids.title: And for kids it's simply a game ⭐
kids.lead: TwoMeows runs a «School of Superheroes»: for every story finished and word learned, the child earns rewards.
kids.f1: Superhero power levels — listen to stories and grow stronger
kids.f3: Word treasury — a collection of all learned words
kids.f4: A daily gift — a little joy every day

method.title: Why it works 🎓
method.m1d: Between ages 2 and 7 a child's brain absorbs languages naturally, with no cramming. It's the «golden window» of early development — and stories make the most of it.
method.m2d: The child hears the word, sees the picture and follows the highlighted text all at once. Three channels of perception — three times stronger memory.
method.m3d: Words come back in different tales and in the review mode after each story. A favourite tale can be played again and again — and that's learning too.
method.m4d: Words heard in a beloved story stick better than any flashcards. Emotion is the strongest glue for memory.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions 💬
faq.q1: From what age can my child use the app?
faq.a1: From age 2. The youngest get short tales and lullabies with simple words; kids aged 5–7 get longer adventures with richer vocabulary. The age is shown on every story.
faq.a2: Every story is reviewed before publication by an educator — a specialist in early childhood development. We check the content, vocabulary, narration pace and age fit.
faq.a3: Right now the stories are narrated in Ukrainian with Slovak word learning. We are working on new language pairs — including Polish and English.
faq.q4: Does it need a constant internet connection?
faq.a4: No. A downloaded story can be played offline — on the road, at the cottage or on a plane.
faq.q5: What is free and what requires a subscription?
faq.a5: The first stories are completely free — feel free to try. A subscription unlocks the whole library and the new tales added every week.
faq.q6: Is the app safe for my child?
faq.a6: Yes. No ads, no external links, no purchases reachable by a child. Settings and subscription are protected by parental access.
